build_SafeFragment_load: build a SafeFragment from a parquet file fragment and load all or specific columns into a PyArrow table
build_list_parquet_fragments: build a pipeline to list parquet fragments with optional row group splitting and shuffle window support
build_build_batching_loop_over_one_table: build a batching loop over a single PyArrow table with optional length ordering and max tokens constraints
build_build_basic_parquet_data_pipeline: build a complete parquet data loading pipeline using BasicDataLoadingConfig with fragment streaming and table bucketing
